overview.purpose_zh: 这张图只看名次，不看具体数值：六款笔记应用在上半年每个月的应用商店排名怎么变，谁上升、谁下滑、谁和谁换了位置。
works_zh: 适合比较几个对象的排名随时间的变化
适合一眼看出谁在哪一个月超过了谁
uses_zh: 月度经营复盘里讲自己产品的排名走势
竞品分析时说明名次更替的时点

understanding.read_zh: 先看纵轴：第 1 名在最上面，数字越大位置越低，所以线往上走代表名次变好，不是数值变大。再找交叉点：两条线交叉，说明两个应用在那一个月互换了名次。最后看谁在顶部待得久，而不是只看最后一个月谁第一。

elements.note_zh: 纵轴是名次，1 在顶端，越往下名次越差。
横向的每一列是一个月，从左到右按时间排列。
每条线从头连到尾，线的形状就是名次的故事。
两条线交叉表示两个应用互换名次，不是数值反超。

look_for_zh: 先看谁最后停在第 1 名，再看它从哪个月开始往上走
找交叉最多的一段，那里名次变化最频繁

observations.en: Our app moved up in every month except March, from 5 in January to 1 in June.
observations.zh: 除了三月，我们的应用每个月都在上升，从一月的第 5 名一路走到六月的第 1 名。

observations.en: Three different apps held 1st place: App A in January and February, App B from March to May, and Our app in June.
observations.zh: 三个不同的应用坐过第 1 名：App A 在一月和二月，App B 从三月到五月，我们的应用在六月。

observations.en: App A slipped from 1st to 3rd, and App D fell from 4th to 6th, the lowest place on the chart.
observations.zh: App A 从第 1 名滑到第 3 名，App D 从第 4 名掉到第 6 名，也就是整张图的最低位置。

observations.en: In June, Our app and App B swapped the top two places: Our app moved from 2 to 1, and App B from 1 to 2.
observations.zh: 六月，我们的应用和 App B 交换了前两名：我们的应用从第 2 升到第 1，App B 从第 1 降到第 2。

observations.en: App C moved up once, from 3 in January to 2 in February, then slid to 4 by April and stayed there.
observations.zh: App C 只上升过一次，从一月的第 3 到二月的第 2，之后滑到四月的第 4 名就停住了。

describe.en: The bump chart shows the monthly app store rank of six note-taking apps from January to June.
describe.zh: 这张排名变化图显示六款笔记应用一月到六月每个月的应用商店排名。
describe.pattern: The chart shows + what + for whom + over what period
alternatives: The chart tracks six apps and where each one ranked in each month.
The bump chart compares monthly ranks, not sales figures.
describe.note_zh: 开头强调「名次」而不是「销量」，读者才不会把高低当成数值大小。

describe.en: Our app climbed from 5th in January to 1st in June, passing one rival at a time.
describe.zh: 我们的应用从一月的第 5 名一路攀升到六月的第 1 名，一次超过一个对手。
alternatives: Our app rose from 5 to 1 over the six months.
Our app's rank improved in every month except March.
describe.note_zh: climb 暗示一步一步往上，正好对应这条每格上升一名的线。

describe.en: App A dropped from 1st to 3rd between January and June.
describe.zh: App A 在一月到六月之间从第 1 名跌到第 3 名。
alternatives: App A lost two places over the half-year.
App A fell from 1 to 3 and never returned to the top.
describe.note_zh: drop 比 fall 口语一点，讲名次时两个都可以，后面都接 from ... to ...。

describe.en: Our app finished 1st in June, closely followed by App B in 2nd.
describe.zh: 我们的应用六月排在第 1，App B 紧跟在第 2。
describe.pattern: A + lead + closely followed by + B
alternatives: Our app led in June, with App B right behind it.
App B finished 2nd, closely behind Our app.
describe.note_zh: 名次相邻用 closely followed by 很自然；如果中间隔了好几个位置，就不适合加 closely。

describe.en: Overall, the top of the chart changed hands twice, while App D and App E stayed in the bottom two places from February onward.
describe.zh: 总体来看，榜首换过两次手，而 App D 和 App E 从二月起一直待在最后两名。
alternatives: Overall, three different apps held 1st place across the six months.
Overall, the biggest moves happened at the top, not the bottom.
describe.note_zh: Overall 后面必须是判断或对比，不能只重复「这张图显示了排名」。

describe.en: The key takeaway here is that Our app ended 1st while App A, the January leader, finished 3rd.
describe.zh: 这里最关键的一点是：我们的应用最后排在第 1，而一月的领先者 App A 只排到第 3。
describe.pattern: The key takeaway here is + that + clause
alternatives: The key takeaway is a clean climb from 5th to 1st.
The main point is that the lead changed hands three times.
describe.note_zh: 收尾句把最重要的一条压成一句，直接给结论，不要再把每个应用念一遍。

academic.en: The bump chart tracks the monthly app store rank of six note-taking apps from January to June 2026. Rank 1 sits at the top of the chart and rank 6 at the bottom, so a line that moves upward represents a better position even though its number falls. Our app improved in every month except March, moving from 5th to 1st. App A, the leader in January, slipped to 3rd by June, while App D fell from 4th to 6th. App B held 1st from March to May and ended 2nd. The chart shows positions only, so the size of the gap between neighboring ranks cannot be read from the spacing.
academic.zh: 这张排名变化图追踪六款笔记应用 2026 年一月到六月的月度应用商店排名。第 1 名在图的顶端，第 6 名在底部，所以线往上走代表位置更好，尽管数字在变小。我们的应用除了三月之外每个月都在进步，从第 5 名升到第 1 名。一月的领先者 App A 到六月滑到第 3，App D 则从第 4 掉到第 6。App B 从三月到五月守住第 1，最后排在第 2。这张图只呈现名次，相邻名次之间差距有多大，从线的间距读不出来。

business.en: Our app finished the half-year at 1st, up from 5th in January, and that is the headline for the next team meeting. The climb was steady rather than sudden: 4th in February, 4th again in March, 3rd in April, 2nd in May and 1st in June. The early leader, App A, slides to 3rd, so the app we were chasing in January is no longer the one to watch. App B is: it held 1st for three months and only gave it up in June. The next quarter's goal writes itself, which is to defend the top spot against App B.
business.zh: 我们的应用以第 1 名结束这半年，高于一月的第 5 名，这就是下次团队会议的开场结论。上升是稳步的，不是突然的：二月第 4，三月还是第 4，四月第 3，五月第 2，六月第 1。早先领先的 App A 滑到第 3，所以一月时我们追赶的那个应用已经不再是重点。重点是 App B：它守住第 1 名三个月，直到六月才让出。下个季度的目标很自然：守住第一，盯住 App B。

simple.en: This chart shows where six apps ranked each month. Number 1 is the best place, so when a line goes up, the app is doing better. Our app started at 5 in January and ended at 1 in June. App A started at 1 and finished at 3. App B was number 1 for three months, then dropped to 2. App D went the other way, from 4 to 6. The chart only shows places, not how far ahead each app was.
simple.zh: 这张图显示六款应用每个月的排名。第 1 名是最好的位置，所以线往上走就是表现变好。我们的应用一月从第 5 名开始，六月到了第 1。App A 从第 1 开始，最后第 3。App B 当了三个月第 1，然后掉到第 2。App D 方向相反，从第 4 掉到第 6。这张图只看名次，不显示每个应用领先多少。

language_notes.title_en: moved up to 1st, not increased to 1
language_notes.body_zh: 名次是「越小越好」，所以图上往上走，文字里说 move up to 1st 或 climb to 1st，不说 increase to 1。数字在变小，位置在变好，这两种说法要分开记。
examples: Our app moved up from 5th to 1st.

language_notes.title_en: hold, take and lose a place
language_notes.body_zh: 讲名次常用三个动词：hold 是保住某个位置，take 是拿到，lose 是丢掉；互换位置说 swap places。比笼统地用 be 更有画面。
examples: App B held 1st from March to May.
Our app took 1st in June, and App B lost it.

language_notes.body_zh: rank 1 是数据里的写法，句子更自然的是 in 1st place、finished 1st，正式报告也可以说 ranked first。同一个意思，三种说法按场合挑。
examples: App A ranked first in January.
